name: Tribal Chief Supervises the Hospital
description: Dropping the Tribal Chief on the Hospital hotspot (Medicine level 2 or more) makes him walk to the spot where he stands when he is "Concerned about the sick" and do the game's own "Directing work" action there; in the stock game he does nothing and picks another task. While he directs work there, a healer who finishes studying medicine at the hospital gains twice the usual Medicine skill points (at least 1); the chance to learn is not changed, so this does not stack with the Medicine technology's cure bonus. A healer whose cure roll fails also gets a second chance: the chief's supervision roll, which passes about 25% of the time per Leadership level, lets the cure go ahead as if the healer had passed. The stock game gives the chief that supervision bonus for fishing, fruit, honey, huts, research and puzzles, but never for a cure. **Unverified in play: the effect has not been tested live.** This patch needs no other row and does not add the Origins Upgrades buttons. It is on by default for The Secret City; untick it to keep the stock game. The companion is "VVFP VV3 Chief Hospital.dll", started by VVFP Startup.dll; if the DLL cannot be loaded, the stock game runs.
behavior_changes: The chief's site switch 0x458C70 gives site 9 (the Hospital, written by the drop handler 0x4215E0 at 0x4215F6) the stock Directing-work order (0x458D4C: action 0x81, handler 0x44B5F0, text 0x219 eSayDirectWork "Directing work") instead of clearing the site at 0x458D0B: the index byte at 0x458D94 becomes 0x0B, the index the other directed sites use.

In the Directing-work handler, site 9 stands where "Concerned about the sick" stands (action 0x8A, handler 0x452540, text 0x1E4: (0x47B + rand(0x96), 0x665 + rand(0x32))): the handler's bases become 0x47B + rand(0x79) and 0x665 + rand(0x15), so its walks of base + rand(0x1E) stay inside that area, and the handler's own plain pose (0x44B86B) runs.

Studying medicine (action 0xBD, handler 0x451890) ends with a Medicine practice step (script op 7, skill 2, run at 0x462051 as 0x45A2C0); when that step succeeds while the chief is alive, not sick, on site 9 and doing action 0x81, the Medicine points it adds (0x45A753, written by 0x455740, capped at 100) are doubled, and at least 1.

When a healer's Healing roll in a cure fails (the roll at 0x457395), the game asks the chief's supervision roll 0x45FC60 for the Hospital site (9). That roll passes only when the Tribal Chief is alive, not sick, standing on the hospital hotspot (+0xEA0 = 9), and rand(100) < 25 x Leadership level; then the cure continues as a passed Healing roll does.
A passed Healing roll is unchanged, and so is every cure when no chief is on the hospital: the supervision roll then draws nothing from the game's random generator.
explicit_non_changes: This row changes no executable bytes: VVFP VV3 Chief Hospital.dll verifies the stock bytes at each place and writes its changes at run time; a different build of the game installs nothing. The Directing-work changes are installed all together or not at all.
The chief's supervision is unchanged everywhere else: fishing, fruit, honey, huts, research and puzzles keep their stock bonuses, and the chief still never picks a job.

Every other site's Directing work, the chief's other choices and their order are stock: when a villager is doing action 0x2D the chief still does "Concerned about the sick" (0x45BDED) before directing work, as in the stock game.
The Medicine learning chance, cures, other skills and every other villager's study are unchanged; the bonus applies only to the study step of a villager on action 0xBD.
A healer who dislikes medicine still fails half of their cures, as in the stock game; a chief's success is a pass of the Healing roll, not a guaranteed cure.
Catch-up healing (the cure scan at 0x45B94A) is not changed by this row.
Nothing is written to a villager record, the save or any file.

runtime_detours.routine: the healer's cure (0x457350): the test of the Healing roll's result, after its call at 0x457395; a failed roll asks the chief's supervision roll for the hospital (0x45FC60(9)) before the stock failure at 0x457431
the Directing-work handler (0x44B5F0, action 0x81): its site jump; site 9 gets the Concerned-about-the-sick area and the plain pose 0x44B86B, every other site takes the stock jump

the practice roll (0x45A2C0), Medicine success: the gain before the skill writer call at 0x45A75C; doubled (at least 1) for the study step (return 0x46206B) of a villager on action 0xBD while the chief directs work on site 9
the chief's site switch (0x458C70): site 9's index byte; 0x0B sends it to the Directing-work order 0x458D4C (checked with the table entry before it, 4C8D4500, and written last)
